name: Circle USDC
description: USD-pegged stablecoin issued by Circle. Each USDC is redeemable 1:1 for US dollars. Reserves held in cash and short-term US Treasuries at regulated financial institutions. Monthly third-party attestations by Deloitte. De-pegged to $0.87 during SVB crisis (March 2023) when $3.3B in reserves were trapped at Silicon Valley Bank. The largest regulated stablecoin by compliance profile. Approximately $52B in circulation.

name: TER Gold
description: Bhutan's sovereign gold-backed SPL Token-2022 on Solana, issued by the Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority (GMCA). 1 TER = 0.01 grams of 99.99% fine gold (London Good Delivery standard). Launched December 17, 2025. Technology powered by Matrixdock (Matrixport subsidiary), which holds a Financial Services Licence from GMCA's GFSO. Gold custodied at DK Bank (Digital Kidu Bank), Bhutan's first licensed digital bank regulated by the Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan. Phase 1 uses institutional custody model with KYC via DK Bank onboarding. TER also serves as a required deposit for Bhutan's Digital Nomad Visa program ($10,000 USD equivalent held in smart contract). No independent third-party audit report published as of March 2026.
statusNote: Live: ter.bt offers mint and redemption and the mint holds 11,606,617 TER (~116 kg gold); on-chain symbol is TER, not TERG. https://ter.bt/
